messages:
ana (Product): Quick sync — drafting DP engagement + feedback runbook for the next beta. Need alignment on recruitment, incentives, feedback cadence, and rollout gating. PTAL.

mike (DevEx): can do. want a short runbook or a longer playbook?

ana (Product): Short runbook for ops + a one-pager we can hand to partners. Keep the playbook internal.

eva (Customer Success): goal from CS: 5 high-touch partners, weekly touchpoints for first 4 weeks, then biweekly. incentives: $2k credit or early access feature.

sara (Eng PM): engineering constraints: support window for DPs is 9am-5pm PT, triage SLA 4 hours. we should set clear regression gates.

lee (Sales): recruiting idea: prioritize customers with 1) infra readiness (VPC/dedicated), 2) product use-case alignment (search, summarization), 3) exec sponsor. I can surface a short list of 12 prospects.

ana (Product): nice. draft runbook should include: screener, onboarding checklist, feedback cadence, evals, success metrics, and escalation path.

mike (DevEx): draft screener below — feedback welcome:
```
1) Primary use-case?
2) Expected monthly tokens/embeddings?
3) Data sensitivity (public/internal/regulated)?
4) Can you join 1-2 weekly 30m sessions for 4 weeks?
5) Does your infra allow VPN/VPC or are you using hosted?
```

eva (Customer Success): add: "Willingness to share labeled prompt failures for evals"

sara (Eng PM): Onboarding checklist suggestion:
```
- NDA signed
- Account + API keys provisioned
- Test workload + baseline metrics collected
- Run smoke tests (latency < X ms, throughput target)
- Instrument eval harness (5 canonical prompts)
```

ana (Product): good. For success metrics propose these minima: 1) 3 partners actively using >50% of planned calls after 4 weeks, 2) median latency within 20% of baseline, 3) no more than 1 P0 regression across eval set, 4) qualitative NPS >= 7 from partner feedback.

lee (Sales): timeline ask: recruiting finished in 3 weeks, onboarding staggered over next 6 weeks. can sales commit? I can run outreach if product confirms screener.

ana (Product): yes. Sales run outreach. We’ll prioritize by readiness and strategic fit.

mike (DevEx): feedback loop ops: weekly partner syncs + centralized feedback doc. engineering triage: all P0/P1 flagged in that doc get a weekly review meeting. Add a Slack channel per partner for realtime logs.

eva (Customer Success): recommend a template for partner feedback: one-line outcome, reproduction steps, severity, impact, suggested priority. keeps notes scannable.

sara (Eng PM): rollout gating criteria (must pass all):
- onboarding checklist complete for at least 3 partners
- no P0 regressions for 7 days on eval harness
- onboarding docs + SDK samples published
- runbook for support + escalation triaged with SRE

nana (Product): escalation path: partner -> CS -> Eng PM -> Incident oncall. define SLA timers in runbook (ack within 1h, initial triage in 4h).

lee (Sales): incentive fine. Also propose an "early adopter" badge + case study option to sweeten recruitment.

mike (DevEx): small ops note: collect anonymized prompts for quality evals — ensure we ask for consent and redact PII.

eva (Customer Success): agreed. add consent checkbox in screener + onboarding.

sara (Eng PM): who owns the eval harness? Research or Eng? we need owners for maintenance and to add new regression tests from partner reports.

ana (Product): assign Research to own model-quality harness; Eng owns infra/eval CI. Product owns partner success criteria & rollout decisions.

mike (DevEx): I'll draft the one-pager for partners and the internal runbook. putting a checklist + sample screener + contact matrix. ETA end of week.

ana (Product): perfect. action items:
- lee: outreach list & first-touch message (due: 3 days)
- mike: one-pager + internal runbook draft (due: EOW)
- eva: feedback template + consent copy (due: EOW)
- sara: confirm triage SLA + eval owners (due: 2 days)
- ana: finalize success metrics and gating (due: 2 days)

oncall-bot: Reminder: create private channels for partner logs once first partner onboarded.

ana (Product): thanks all — will follow up in thread with draft docs. :rocket:
